body:
yeah it's joon's. we spent yesterday experimenting a little with the onchain proposal process, we used the How To Make It In Crypto-Media podcast as its was the lowest cost proposal - aim was to figure out the correct process for pushing simpleMajority for all proposals rather than the existing superMajority. 

We just need to agree next steps if/when this passes.

Is this Joon's proposal? 

If so, it seems to be coded wrong - if this proposal passes, it will _propose a spend_ which will then become a treasury proposal - unless we are trying to avoid paying a proposal bond here.
